gates.name: Credentials and permissions
gates.evidence: The adapter supports API-key/secret authentication and no withdrawal method, but this audit never reads or verifies Railway secrets or Bitvavo key permissions.
gates.required_action: Verify the key has View + Trade digital assets, no withdrawals, and IP restriction; keep values only in Railway secrets.

gates.name: Connectivity and controlled test
gates.evidence: Public ticker code exists, but Bitvavo has no configured testnet/sandbox path in this repository; no private order test was attempted.
gates.required_action: Add a venue-supported non-production test or keep shadow mode; do not use a real order as a first connectivity test.

gates.name: Hard trade, daily-loss and slippage limits
gates.evidence: ExecutionGateway validates per-order EUR notional, daily exposure, daily loss and slippage before any adapter call.

gates.name: Idempotency and duplicate-order protection
gates.evidence: ExecutionGateway rejects missing or duplicate client_order_id values.

gates.name: Order reconciliation and partial fills
gates.evidence: The current adapter exposes account/balance/place/cancel only; no durable open-order, fill, partial-fill or post-order reconciliation loop was found.
gates.required_action: Implement durable order journal, order-status polling, fill accounting, partial-fill handling and cancel/replace recovery.

gates.name: Restart recovery and durable execution state
gates.evidence: No durable execution journal or restart checkpoint was found for live orders; the gateway counters are in-memory.
gates.required_action: Persist accepted/submitted/filled/canceled state and reconcile it before allowing a restarted worker to trade.

gates.name: Kill switch, authentication and operator monitoring
gates.evidence: Emergency-stop, confirmation phrase, dashboard auth and risk kill-switch code exist; live capability is intentionally still reported as not_installed until gates 1, 2, 5 and 6 are complete.
gates.required_action: Keep EMERGENCY_STOP=true until all preceding gates pass and perform an independent operational review.
